subject.title: feat: expose readable session presentation metadata

question: Should this closed session-family and title-source taxonomy become the permanent additive Gateway client contract, and if so, how must future unknown families be represented to older clients?
rationale: Tests can prove the current values and privacy behavior, but they cannot decide the long-term public taxonomy or mixed-version compatibility policy that native clients will depend on.

options.title: Approve with evolution rule
options.body: Keep the projection, define canonical title precedence, and require the Gateway to map future unrecognized families to `unknown` until a versioned protocol change permits new literals.

options.title: Narrow the contract
options.body: Expose safe title and foreground/background metadata now while deferring the detailed family enum until its categories and extension policy are settled.

options.title: Pause protocol expansion
options.body: Defer the PR and keep presentation heuristics client-side until maintainers approve a cross-client taxonomy.

recommendation.title: Approve with evolution rule
recommendation.body: Keep the projection, define canonical title precedence, and require the Gateway to map future unrecognized families to `unknown` until a versioned protocol change permits new literals.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the linked issue and coordinated both the producing Gateway surface and consuming Windows implementation, making them the strongest available decision-routing candidate.
